run_wav2vec_unsupervised_inference: run inference for pre-processed audio data with a trained wav2vec unsupervised model using viterbi or kenlm decoding
run_cli_main: run the w2vu_generate CLI to generate transcriptions from audio features using a trained wav2vec model
run_main_with_config: run the main generation function with an UnsupGenerateConfig to transcribe audio and compute WER scores
run_generate_function: run the generate function to perform batch inference on a dataset and collect error statistics
run_process_predictions: run process_predictions to post-process decoder hypotheses and compute edit distance against target tokens
